description: This Java class 'DittoJwtAuthorizationSubjectsProvider' provides an implementation of the JwtAuthorizationSubjectsProvider interface. It is responsible for deriving authorization subjects from a JSON Web Token (JWT) based on a configuration of valid issuers. The class includes methods for instantiation, generating authorization subjects from a token, and standard object methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: DittoJwtAuthorizationSubjectsProvider
classes.description: Implements JWT authorization subject provision for specific issuer configurations, providing methods to instantiate, compare, and represent the provider object.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance with a given JwtSubjectIssuersConfig.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Extracts authorization subjects from a given JsonWebToken based on the issuer configuration.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on jwtSubjectIssuersConfig.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on jwtSubjectIssuersConfig.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the provider including its configuration.
